title: Serverless Event Processing with Azure Functions
description: Build asynchronous, event-driven background AI pipelines using Azure Functions isolated worker model in .NET.

data.text: Serverless Event Processing with .NET Isolated Worker

In modern AI systems, long-running ingestion, embedding calculation, and batch evaluation tasks should never run synchronously on the user-facing web server. Azure Functions provides serverless, event-driven compute that scales automatically from zero to thousands of instances based on event volume. In modern .NET (.NET 8/9), Azure Functions runs on the Isolated Worker Model, giving developers full control over the application startup, middleware pipeline, and dependency injection.

data.text: On standard Consumption plans, serverless instances scale to zero when idle, incurring cold starts (1-3 seconds) on initial invocation. For latency-sensitive HTTP AI endpoints, deploy to the Azure Functions Flex Consumption or Premium Plan, which maintains pre-warmed instances and provides virtual network integration.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure Functions offloads heavy AI ingestion and batch jobs from main web servers
Use the .NET Isolated Worker Model for full control over dependency injection and middleware
Combine Blob Storage triggers and Service Bus queues for resilient, decoupled pipelines
Cosmos DB Change Feed enables real-time vector index synchronization
Choose Flex Consumption or Premium plans for pre-warmed instances and VNet integration
data.takeaway: Azure Functions is the engine of asynchronous AI data pipelines in .NET. Event-driven triggers and automatic scaling ensure background processing remains fast, decoupled, and cost-efficient.
